meta.title: የእሷ እርምጃ
meta.logline: A girl walks out of an arranged marriage into the dark highlands, and the step she takes becomes the road her granddaughter stands on.
meta.audience: My family first, on a phone: my mother's generation, who knew her, and my cousins born in Addis and abroad who only know her name. Then the cohort and anyone who has a grandmother they wish they had asked more questions about.
meta.intent: They should feel that one frightened, barefoot decision is the reason their own life exists where it does, and they should want to go and ask an elder for the story they have not asked for yet.

consent.details: Subject is my late grandmother. Her living children (including my parent) have been asked and have agreed, and the record is in ETHICS.md. Consent covers (a) a stylised painted depiction informed by the one surviving family photograph, (b) the invented first-person words placed in her mouth, and (c) publication to the course and to social platforms with an AI label. Her photograph is a likeness reference only; it is never shown on screen and she is not named in the film or its public posts.
